question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Bacterium**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A "**pathogen**" is a microorganism, such as a bacterium, virus, or other infectious agent, that causes disease in its host (which can be a plant, animal, or human). 
 
• **Bacterium **is the singular form of bacteria, which are microscopic organisms that can cause diseases. (जीवाणु)
 
• The word is derived from Greek and means "small staff" or "little rod".
 
• Bacteria can be harmful or beneficial to humans and other living beings.
 
• They can be found everywhere, from soil and water to the human gut and skin.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Medicine **refers to drugs or other substances used to treat or prevent diseases. (औषधि)
 
• **Potion **is a magical or medicinal drink, often associated with folklore and fantasy. (मिश्रित औषधि)
 
• **Solution **can mean a liquid mixture of two or more substances or a way to solve a problem. (समाधान)
